purpose: Draws the 11-frame warp-portal OPEN animation at a given battle tile (first half of the character-warp visual: the portal materialises at the source/destination tile).
logic_summary: Loops frame_iter = 0..0xA (11 frames). Each frame: (1) fetch the frame's sprite address from the portrait sheet's 11-entry sprite sub-table at +0x1B8 (entry index = frame_iter + 0x72, read as *(int*)(portrait_sheet + 6 + (frame_iter+0x72)*4) + portrait_sheet); (2) memmove the caller's 0x25680-byte snapshot back into the large game-state buffer to restore the backdrop; (3) compute the tile's working-surface address = large_game_state_buffer + (tile_y - origin_y)*0x2AC0 + (tile_x - origin_x)*0x18 + 0x8250; (4) blit the portal sprite there via fd2_blit_sprite_with_decoded_pixels(target, sprite, 0x1C8); (5) repaint characters on top via fd2_composite_all_chars_overlay(); (6) push the viewport to the mode-13h framebuffer via fd2_blit_rectangle(0xA0504, 0x140, large_game_state_buffer+0x8088, 0x1C8, 0x138, 0xC0); (7) fd2_wait_n_bios_ticks(1). Cyclomatic complexity 2 (single loop). The __CHK(0x2c) stack-probe is compiler-injected, not source.
